int_name: E HUNTING PARK AVE & L ST

result.summary: This residential street features a signalized intersection that lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or dedicated pedestrian signals. The wide, unmarked roadway and presence of parked cars near the corners increase exposure and potential for sightline obstructions.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalk
hazards.description: There are no visible pavement markings to designate a pedestrian crossing area at this signalized intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground intersection area

hazards.name: Wide Roadway Exposure
hazards.description: The wide, unmarked roadway increases the distance and time pedestrians must spend in the path of vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center roadway

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corners may obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Curb sides near the foreground

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install ladder or zebra-style crosswalk markings to clearly define the pedestrian path and alert drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear guidance on when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to reduce crossing distance, improve sightlines, and slow turning traffic.

result.summary: The intersection features a sidewalk and vehicle traffic signals but lacks basic pedestrian crossing infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals. The roadway surface is in poor condition with visible cracking, and sight lines are partially obstructed by a vehicle parked near the corner.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection to designate a safe path for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection lacks dedicated pedestrian signal heads, leaving pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.
hazards.location_in_image: On the utility and signal poles at the corner

hazards.name: Sight Line Obstruction
hazards.description: A silver SUV is parked very close to the intersection, potentially blocking the view between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground near the church entrance

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Significant cracking and wear on the road surface could present a tripping hazard or affect vehicle braking.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the foreground roadway

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and prevent vehicles from parking too close to the intersection.

result.summary: This wide intersection lacks basic pedestrian safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signals. The long crossing distance across multiple lanes of traffic creates a high-exposure environment for people walking, despite the presence of sidewalks.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path across the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground and middle ground across the intersection

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection is controlled by traffic lights but lacks dedicated pedestrian signal heads, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicular signals.
hazards.location_in_image: Mounted on utility poles and overhead wires at the intersection

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway width increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicular traffic without any refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Spanning the entire width of the main road

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way and timing information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and pedestrian signals. However, the wide four-lane roadway and lack of a median refuge island result in a long, unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crossing across the main roadway

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb line can block sight lines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the curb

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area and allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles receive a green light.
